question:
**Direction: In the following sentence, an idiom is highlighted. Select the alternative which best describes its use in the sentence.**

By the end of the football match, feelings had __reached fever pitch__.

options.text: to get so strong that one cannot control them

solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "to get so strong that one cannot control them."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase '**reach fever pitch**' means 'to become very intense and exciting, or very desperate.' (बहुत तीव्र और रोमांचक; इतना मजबूत होना कि कोई उन्हें नियंत्रित न कर सके)
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *After a second night of rioting, tensions in the city **reached a fever pitch.****​*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 2, 'to get so strong that one cannot control them,' which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *to get so strong that one cannot control them.*
